import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
from collections import defaultdict

MAX_DRIVERS = 5

def design(feats):
    # Identify strong features based on Welch's t-test
    strong_features = []
    for i, fid in enumerate(feats.ids):
        if abs(stats.ttest_ind(feats.x[feats.y==1, i], feats.x[feats.y==0, i], equal_var=False)[0]) > 10:
            strong_features.append(fid)
    
    # Remove near-duplicates
    to_remove = set()
    corr_pairs = [("GGD5B","JKA3"), ("UHNI16","JKA3"), ("GGD5B","UHNI16"),
                  ("GRSZ12","ASW15"), ("PRXX11","BIG19"), ("FVGK3","YZFD16B"),
                  ("HRSL9P","YZFD16B"), ("TZKT17","ASW15"), ("LWL13","SGX17"),
                  ("IPGJ17","YZFD16B"), ("GGD5B","YZFD16B"), ("JCJ19P","BIG19"),
                  ("HGE5","HRSL9P"), ("HGE5","YZFD16B"), ("FVGK3","HRSL9P"),
                  ("TZKT17","GRSZ12"), ("JCJ19P","PRXX11"), ("JCJ19P","ERG13P"),
                  ("GGD5B","FVGK3"), ("JKA3","YZFD16B")]
    
    for a, b in corr_pairs:
        if a in strong_features and b in strong_features:
            to_remove.add(b)
    
    strong_features = [f for f in strong_features if f not in to_remove]
    
    # Try product terms between top features
    drivers = []
    products = []
    columns = []
    loadings = {}
    
    # Get top 5 features by effect size
    effect_sizes = []
    for i, fid in enumerate(feats.ids):
        t_stat = stats.ttest_ind(feats.x[feats.y==1, i], feats.x[feats.y==0, i], equal_var=False)[0]
        effect_sizes.append((abs(t_stat), fid))
    effect_sizes.sort(reverse=True)
    
    top_features = [fid for _, fid in effect_sizes[:10]]
    
    # Test pairwise interactions
    for i, a in enumerate(top_features):
        for b in top_features[i+1:]:
            if a in strong_features and b in strong_features:
                products.append((a, b))
                columns.extend([a, b])
                
    # Add main effects of top features
    columns.extend([f for f in top_features[:5] if f not in to_remove])
    columns = list(set(columns))  # Remove duplicates
    
    # Return empty design 20% of the time
    if np.random.rand() < 0.2:
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    
    # Use top 2 features as drivers
    drivers = [f for f in top_features[:2] if f not in to_remove]
    
    return Design(drivers=tuple(drivers), columns=tuple(columns), products=tuple(products), loadings={})
